tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Why are you late?"
B hears the question and builds the answer. Because gives the reason, so gives the result. Put the blue verb into the right form: past (missed), -s (says) or is / was.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Because for the reason, so for the result.
